name: HELMET
intro: HELMET是一个全面的基准测试，旨在有效且彻底地评估长上下文语言模型（LCLMs）。它涵盖了七个多样化的、以应用为中心的类别，解决了现有基准测试中存在的覆盖范围有限、上下文长度不足和评估指标不可靠等问题。HELMET通过增加可控的上下文长度（高达128K tokens）、基于模型的评估和少样本提示，提供了更可靠和一致的LCLM排名。研究发现，合成任务不能可靠预测下游性能，且HELMET中不同类别之间趋势各异、相关性低。
build_method: 公开长上下文任务策划、可控长度构造与任务适配评测
metric: SubEM, Citation metrics, NDCG@10, Accuracy, ROUGE F1, GPT-4o model-based scores
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题, 摘要, 信息检索, 文本生成
eval_feature: 七类应用导向任务、128K+可控上下文、稳健少样本提示与参考式模型评测
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Multiple Choice, Summarization, information retrieval, text generation
build_method_en: Public-task curation, controllable-length construction, and task-appropriate evaluation
eval_feature_en: Seven application-centric categories, controllable 128K+ contexts, robust few-shot prompts, and reference-based model evaluation
intro_en: HELMET is a comprehensive benchmark designed to effectively and thoroughly evaluate long-context language models (LCLMs). It covers seven diverse, application-focused categories, addressing limitations in existing benchmarks such as limited coverage, insufficient context length, and unreliable evaluation metrics. HELMET offers more reliable and consistent LCLM rankings by incorporating controllable context lengths (up to 128K tokens), model-based evaluation, and few-shot prompting. Studies show that synthetic tasks do not reliably predict downstream performance, and trends vary with low correlation across different categories within HELMET.
metric_en: SubEM, citation metrics, NDCG@10, accuracy, ROUGE F1, GPT-4o model-based scores

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.02694 and the official princeton-nlp/HELMET repository. HELMET targets four weaknesses in long-context evaluation: limited application coverage, inadequate length, unreliable metrics, and incompatibility with base models. It curates seven categories and 21 dataset/task configurations: RAG, citation generation, passage re-ranking, many-shot ICL, long-document QA, summarization, and synthetic recall. Evidence tasks vary retrieved or ranked passages and gold positions; ICL varies balanced shots; long documents are truncated from the end; synthetic tasks control generated length and placement, supporting 128K tokens and beyond. Most tasks use two-shot prompts, with variable-shot ICL and original RULER settings. Direct metrics include SubEM, citation metrics, NDCG@10, accuracy, and ROUGE F1. GPT-4o grades NarrativeQA with fluency times normalized correctness and summaries with atomic-claim precision/recall F1 times fluency. The paper compares 59 LCLMs and explicitly argues for a multi-category profile rather than a synthetic proxy.
